title: CryptoDeReport
tagline: A crypto asset tracker similar to CoinGecko that utilizes a decentralized database.
description: DeReort is a decentralized crypt investment position reporting app that allows users to update their crypto investment positionswith buy and sell prices, ticker symbol, quantities and date of trades. We thought that we could use a product like this ourselves as centralized alternatives can be improved
how_its_made: The app features a Next.js front-end employing Rainbow Kit and WAGMI for wallet and contract connections. Its contract was deployed and verified to the Scroll Sepolia Layer 2 chain (https://sepolia-blockscout.scroll.io/address/0x1C2Cf76D04F905992928c345a6861f7ad22d4D16/contracts#address-tabs) and the resulting NFTs are deployed to IPFS.
